title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. kerneri
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. kerneri, commonly known as Alpine kidney vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family Fabaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, and is often employed to treat wounds, burns, and skin conditions such as eczema. The therapeutic actions of Alpine kidney vetch include soothing and protecting the skin, reducing inflammation and pain, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
